module: Flowgraph node "Activity Attempt" (category once_instant, tags activity/mission). Creates a mission attempt via gameplay_missions_progress.newAttempt and outputs it on the table pin "attempt" (tableType attemptData) for the other activity nodes. Fixed pins: bool inputs "passed" and "completed"; output "attempt". Custom input pins added by the user (all types except flow) are copied into the attempt data. Runs once when the flow arrives (workOnce).
notes: The attempt type is always 'attempted': the lines that set it to 'passed'/'completed' depending on the pins are commented out, so the "passed" and "completed" pins have no effect in this node.
The fixed pins (passed, completed) are not copied into the data; only non-fixed pins are.

init.desc: Enables savePins and allowCustomInPins (saved custom input pins).

postInit.desc: Empty (code commented out on attempt type templates).

workOnce.desc: If the flow is active, gathers the non-fixed pins into a table, creates the 'attempted' attempt with this data and puts it on the attempt output pin.
